MAC region covers North Macedonia and Kosovo. Assigned to yugoslavia until 1991, then macedonia_state; Kosovo (UN-administered 1999, independent 2008) is carried in notes/events, and the kosovo entity is omitted because no region cell is available for it.
Montenegro falls mostly within the ALB/SRB cells; after 2006 independence it is noted in serbia/albania text but not separately mapped.

German occupation zones 1945: mapped the western zones to west_germany and the Soviet zone to east_germany (both founded 1949) so the 1945 slice remains continuous with 1949; the 1945 note makes clear no German state existed yet. AUT kept as austria under four-power occupation.

1945 colonial holdings: Libya shown under UK (British Military Administration; Fezzan was French — below cell resolution). French North Africa (TUN/NUM/ORA/MAR/RIF minus Spanish zone) shown under france; Spanish protectorate approximated by RIF under spain until 1956.

Israel 1968-1975: Israeli-occupied Sinai lies below map resolution (EGY cells are Delta/Upper Egypt), so Egypt keeps EGY_N/EGY_S; Golan occupation is flagged via SYR contestedRegions rather than reassignment.
Cyprus from 1975: whole CYP cell kept under cyprus_state with contestedRegions — the Turkish-occupied north ("TRNC" 1983) is below cell resolution.
Northern Ireland (IRL_N) kept under uk throughout; the Troubles 1969-1998 are carried in uk stability/notes.

Donbas 2014: DNR/LNR pockets fall mostly in the STE cell (Donetsk) and DON cell (Luhansk, which is Russian-side anyway); mapped by keeping STE/UKR_E Ukrainian with contested flags, since separatists held only fractions of those cells in 2014.

2022 slice is the post-Kherson-liberation situation (late Nov 2022): russia holds CRM+STE (south corridor + Donbas approximated by STE), ukraine retains UKR_E after the Kharkiv counteroffensive. Zaporizhzhia/Kherson east-bank holdings are approximated by the STE cell.
2025: Russia holds ~19% of Ukraine (Russia Matters/DeepState mid-2025); mapped as CRM+STE with UKR_E contested — the front cuts through cells, so the corridor is approximated at cell resolution.
ISIS 2014: given MES_N (Mosul-Raqqa belt); its Syrian half is carried as a contested flag on SYR, where the Assad regime still held Damascus and the coast.
FR Yugoslavia kept under id "yugoslavia" for 1993-1999 (Serbia & Montenegro), switching to id "serbia" from 2004 (State Union, then independent Serbia 2006) — continuity choice for the merge step.

USSR populations are whole-Union figures (extendsBeyondMap); Russia 1991+ likewise whole-federation. Ukraine 2022/2025 population (38M/33M) reflects refugee outflow and occupied-area ambiguity — estimates vary by several million.

Wealth ranks follow Maddison-style relative GDP per capita: Switzerland/Scandinavia/Netherlands pegged at 5, Soviet bloc 2-3 (E. Germany/Czechoslovakia 3), post-Soviet 1990s trough 1-2, Gulf oil states 5 from 1975.
